title: Rusted Maintenance Tunnel
summary: A narrow, sloping tunnel of corroded metal plates leads downward, its walls lined with exposed wiring and a single flickering emergency light. A rusted hatch lies half-open to the left, and a keypad-mounted cabinet stands against the right wall.
arrival_narration: The air smells of ozone and damp metal as you step into the tunnel. The emergency light hums weakly, casting jagged shadows over a rusted ladder descending into darkness. The hatch to your left groans slightly in the breeze, and the cabinet’s keypad glows faintly blue.

visible_objects: rusted hatch (half-open, requires keycard or manual override)
cracked concrete slab (embedded with a small metal plate)
spatial_anomalies: The ladder’s rungs are uneven; stepping on the third from the top emits a faint metallic *clang*.
The emergency light flickers in sync with a distant hum—like a generator or cooling unit.
